Most people think of Washington as Seattle, the Cascades, or its rugged coastlines and lush green forests. But east of the mountains is a completely different wild and wide open world, where the towns are few and far between, and the locals march to their own drum. Join me for a solo road trip through forgotten towns, isolated communities, and vast stretches of wilderness to discover a side of Washington few outsiders ever see.
